scope: Cold npm-exec installs observed on one macOS machine. Local 0.2.1 is a staging archive, not final public release evidence.

harness.invocation: Current Node executes npm-cli.js exec --yes --cache <fresh cache> --global=false --package=<archive> -- kin --no-open --port <free loopback port>.
harness.windowsBoundary: Structured arguments through Node avoid interpolating archive URLs through npm.cmd. Cleanup uses bounded taskkill.exe /PID <owned process> /T /F plus listener-closure verification; this is not a POSIX graceful signal.
harness.isolation: Every invocation creates an empty cache, unrelated working directory and KIN_DATA_DIR. It removes inherited KIN_*, PORT, RAILWAY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN, NODE_PATH and NODE_OPTIONS. Cleanup removes only its owned temporary directory.
checks: Lockfile resolves the exact requested URL or local archive; installed manifest name/version and bin exist.
Installed --version matches for releases 0.2.1 or newer; 0.2.0 predates this option.
Local health reports local-demo; relay health reports kin-relay/0.1 and encrypted-payloads.
Root HTML and nonempty built JavaScript/CSS assets are served; external working directory remains empty.
macOS npm-exec process group exits after SIGTERM and listener closes without SIGKILL.
harness.metrics: Wall-clock observations, not guarantees. Total time stops before temporary-directory deletion. Byte counts sum logical regular-file lengths without following symlinks, not allocated disk usage. This harness uses prebuilt assets and does not run or time a source UI build.

noGitExperiment.passingSetup: PATH contained only the existing Node/npm bin directory and a temporary directory containing a symlink named sh to /bin/sh. Before launch, spawning git --version with exactly this environment returned ENOENT.
noGitExperiment.machineGit: Git remains installed on the machine. These runs prove Git unavailable through PATH, not a machine with Git uninstalled.
noGitExperiment.negativeExperiment: Both versions failed npm/esbuild installation with spawn sh ENOENT when PATH contained only Node/npm. npm_config_script_shell=/bin/sh did not supply that dependency lifecycle path. Supplying sh on PATH while still excluding Git passed.

findings: Node/npm commands and structured script arguments are compatible with bash and PowerShell; no shell-specific installer syntax was found.
Explicit archive filename kin-people-0.2.1.tgz must change with future package versions.
Windows cleanup is scoped process-tree termination; actual Windows behavior requires the CI result.

limits: Requires preinstalled Node.js 22.19 or newer with npm, a lifecycle shell and internet access for production dependencies.
Fresh installs used approximately 144.5 MB of logical cache files; network, time and disk requirements vary.
No Linux or Windows execution result is recorded here.
No interactive browser rendering, ChatGPT/Claude account, remote deployment or paid service was exercised by this smoke.
Final public v0.2.1 HTTPS installation and final-artifact SHA256 verification remain pending.
